options.name: dsn
options.description: Oracle Data Source Name, i.e. Oracle connection string or TNS alias. This parameter has precedence over hostname, port and service_name

options.name: mode
options.description: The mode with which to connect to the database

options.name: password
options.description: The Oracle user password for the user

options.name: port
options.description: The listener port number on the host

options.name: service_name
options.description: The database service name to connect to

options.name: session_container
options.description: Target PDB name for ALTER SESSION SET CONTAINER when using local SYSDBA connections. When set, the module issues ALTER SESSION SET CONTAINER=<value> before executing. Useful for local BEQ/SYSDBA connections where you connect to CDB but need to operate in a specific PDB.

options.name: user
options.description: The Oracle user name to connect to the database
